info.name: SuperCool Finances
info.description: Every endpoint of the balance service, in the order a reviewer would try them, against the local stack of the README Quickstart. Import it with docs/api/postman/local.postman_environment.json; tokens are minted by the collection's pre-request script. Guide: docs/api/README.md.

exec: // Mints fresh tokens for every request, so nobody runs make token or pastes one: HS256 JWTs of
// the demo users of table 1.2 of spec 008, with the claims of section 1.2 of spec 006 (sub, role,
// iat, exp 15 minutes later, iss, aud), signed with the local demo secret of the environment.
// Every answer carries a correlation id (SYS-R21).
